stage_a_exploratory_asset_allocation.why_it_looked_promising: Risk-Off adds real asset-management value. Even after charging simple one-way turnover costs, the trend-break regime family materially improves return, CAGR, Sharpe, Calmar, and max drawdown versus both pure BTC buy-and-hold and AddOn-only. The result is not a single-point fluke: EMA 200-220 with full risk-off all stay in the same strong plateau.
stage_a_exploratory_asset_allocation.caveat: The study used simplified allocation simulation plus full-sample candidate ranking, so it could not be treated as a formal baseline result.
stage_a_exploratory_asset_allocation.one_line_conclusion: Exploration showed Risk-Off might materially improve the AddOn portfolio, but the result was not execution-aligned enough for formal promotion.

stage_b_aligned_validation.what_changed: This round formally aligns the Risk-Off core module. The overlay sleeve itself is imported from the locked baseline artifact and not re-explored.
stage_b_aligned_validation.result: YES. In the aligned default-tuple framework, AddOn + Risk-Off still beats AddOn-only for the locked narrow candidate set.
stage_b_aligned_validation.one_line_conclusion: Risk-Off survived execution alignment and causality audit, but the evidence was only strong enough for aligned-but-preliminary status.

stage_c_core_off_weight_and_with_core_vs.one_line_conclusion: Full flat beat partial residual core, and the with-core framework remained more reasonable than a no-core switching framework.

stage_d_promotion_v1.promotion_answer: NO. Risk-Off does not yet clear promotion-candidate validation.
stage_d_promotion_v1.failure_reason: In walk-forward OOS, AddOn + Risk-Off does not beat AddOn-only consistently enough for promotion. It wins only one of three strict OOS windows.
stage_d_promotion_v1.one_line_conclusion: Promotion v1 failed because OOS consistency was too weak and the main blocker was bull/recovery opportunity cost, not EMA instability or causality.

stage_e_promotion_v2.why_hysteresis_worse: Hysteresis delayed recovery without fixing the core OOS problem, so it raised opportunity cost instead of reducing it.
stage_e_promotion_v2.why_two_stage_better: Yes. Best candidate lifts avg delta Return to -11.47pp and avg delta Calmar to -0.174 while keeping major-drawdown MaxDD improvement at +18.24pp.
stage_e_promotion_v2.recommendation: Keep AddOn-only baseline unchanged. At most, run one final narrow promotion check on the single best repair candidate.
stage_e_promotion_v2.one_line_conclusion: Two-stage repair was directionally better than flat or hysteresis, but still not good enough to clear the promotion bar.

stage_f_narrow_promotion_and_final_reent.final_key_issue: Flat-to-risk-on re-entry timing was the last material blocker after trigger and structure issues had already been narrowed down.
stage_f_narrow_promotion_and_final_reent.why_still_failed: No. Evidence still does not reach promotion-candidate level.
stage_f_narrow_promotion_and_final_reent.one_line_conclusion: Even the best re-entry repair candidate improved the profile but still did not reach promotion-candidate strength, so promotion was frozen.

final_conclusion.official_status: Frozen aligned-but-preliminary direction. Not part of the locked baseline.
